requirement: A pilot invitation goes only to its own customer after aMember says yes, once, within the budget and pacing; its unsubscribe link suppresses that address

oracle.invariant: In test mode the invitation door answers REAL_PILOT_OFF; in pilot mode one approved draft makes exactly one messages.send to the recipient's own address, with no [Test] prefix and no X-Tracy-Test header. The message carries List-Unsubscribe with a one-click token, List-Unsubscribe-Post, the footer reason line and unsubscribe link; the placeholder is gone. A second invitation to the same customer answers REAL_ALREADY_INVITED; aMember no plan answers REAL_NOT_MEMBER, an aMember error or no key answers REAL_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN; a full budget answers REAL_PILOT_FULL; a second customer inside 180 s answers REAL_PILOT_PACING. GET of the unsubscribe link changes nothing; the one-click POST writes one suppression row whose identity holds no address; a later send to that address answers REAL_SUPPRESSED; an unknown token answers 404. Through the full app, the one-click POST with no cookie and no Origin is not refused by the cross-site guard. Pilot without AMEMBER_API_KEY reads as test and lists what is missing. Send to customer needs a second press and posts only requestKey and draftRevision.
